items.title: The Wegovy weight loss pill could come to Canada. What we know
items.description: The FDA approved the one-a-day Wegovy pill, the first oral GLP-1 medication for obesity in the U.S., Wegovy manufacturer Novo Nordisk said in a statement Tuesday.

items.description: The Quebec government says it will ask the Supreme Court to hear an appeal aimed at stopping a redrawing of the provincial electoral map.

items.description: The final preparations for Santa Claus' annual Dec. 24 flight are complete after successfully navigating 'several unusual challenges,' NAV Canada said in a statement.
